# Taste v2.1.4 in the Creative OS Harness

The complete 38-file main skill at 6010f91a9935f1c167dfc500fb1a475681892e6b is preserved byte for byte, with upstream LICENSE, README and CHANGELOG. The separate `taste` package retains all 46 files and all 14 original skills at a60a36dc2bb3bb77ccf17f2f62041f5ca8a458b9. Retired/moved entries do not replace their complete originals. Historical content-addressed bundles are not rewritten.

## Routing

Read this adapter before the COMPLETE selected upstream files. `existing` remains the compatible default for incumbent product interfaces; it and explicit `app-screen` read the new main SKILL.md and the entire references/app-screens.md. Workbenches, editors, queues, detail views and reports (including standalone generated reports) use this App Screen run. The public-page run does not apply to those surfaces. Explicit `public-page` selects the main entry, critique and layout references for marketing/read-and-scroll pages; interface fragments still follow App Screen rules. Explicit `dials-v1` selects the full original dial skill in `taste`; it does not apply v2 defaults or assign v1 dials to v2. Read applicable references from the complete package as needed.

## Existing Harness authority and evidence

- The project's approved Foundation, DESIGN.md, confirmed scope and existing stack take precedence. Keep OJO and Impeccable in the same diagnosis, implementation and independent-review flow. A new style proposal uses existing Foundation/scope confirmation; an approved fix needs no duplicate approval workflow.
- Review is read-only: use the full method to identify evidence, impact and remedies in the existing Harness schema. Implementation stays inside the confirmed scope and isolated worktree. Neither a direction draw nor an aesthetic score grants approval.
- For app screens, inventory real objects, data, jobs and current states. Do not invent a dataset, totals, branding, KPIs or successful review to fill a composition. Distinguish zero, unknown, missing evidence and failures. Show the result, next action and blockers first; put contextual help beside the relevant control and optional provenance/logs in labeled disclosures. Preserve full source evidence.
- Review whole pages and internal scroll regions at normal desktop and phone sizes before auxiliary 200% checks. Check density, grouping, spacing, readable labels, navigation, overlays, keyboard/focus and available loading/empty/error states. Never force arbitrary line breaks or hide relevant content to satisfy a meter. Screenshots alone do not prove interaction, unseen routes, physical-device behavior or model application.
- Upstream house-style bans, minimum image/motion counts, chart hue budgets and numeric aesthetic scores are contextual guidance, not universal release gates. Do not strip approved borders, colors, typography, labels or components. Public-page image and motion quotas do not apply to working app screens. Preserve reduced motion and truthful missing-coverage records.
- All upstream scripts, assets and templates remain available but are not automatically executed. Use the Harness tools, capture, source binding, recapture, supplemental evidence and independent QA; do not start a parallel browser/installation/review system or fetch imagery merely because an upstream command suggests it. Name checks actually run and their limitations. Complete package availability is not proof that a model used it, that quality passed or that a human accepted the result.
